content.title: McDonald’s Sauces and Signature Dressings: Dipping Sauces | McDonald’s
content.text: Sauces From creamy, to spicy, to sweet—explore our delicious variety of McDonald’s dipping sauces and condiments. Find your nearest restaurant and order your favorite McDonald’s sauce from our full menu in the app using contactless Mobile Order & Pay* for pickup or McDelivery®. *At participating McDonald’s. Delivery prices may be higher than at restaurants. Delivery/other fees may apply. Two new sauces taking the stage Thanks to The HUNTRIX Meal, you can get the new Hunter Sauce and Demon Sauce with your 10 pc. Chicken McNuggets® combo for lunch and dinner.* Hunter Sauce is a sweet and slightly spicy blend with touches of chili, garlic and pepper, while Demon Sauce is a purple mustard sauce with hints of tang and bold heat. Try both along with the Ramyeon McShaker™ Fries when you order The HUNTRIX Meal today. KPOP DEMON HUNTERS ™/© Netflix. Used with permission. ©2026 The Coca-Cola Company. “Coca-Cola" and "Diet Coke” are registered trademarks of The Coca-Cola Company. *At participating McDonald’s for a limited time, while supplies last. Order in the App Dipping Sauces Creamy Chili McCrispy® Strip Dip Made for McCrispy Strips, the new Creamy Chili Dip is a mix of savory and tangy sweetness with a hint of chili pepper and a nutty, toasted sesame finish. Tangy Barbecue Sauce Our perfect Tangy BBQ Sauce is made with a tomato paste base and has a sweet hickory smoke flavor, vinegar, and savory spices. Spicy Buffalo Sauce Our McDonald's Spicy Buffalo Sauce is a peppery salt and vinegar-flavored sauce, with a slight buttery note and developing heat. Creamy Ranch Sauce McDonald's Creamy Ranch Sauce is a mildly tart ranch sauce with a savory onion and garlic flavor. Honey Mustard Sauce McDonald's Honey Mustard Sauce dipping sauce blends zesty dijon mustard with sweet notes of honey. Honey McDonald's Honey is Grade A Pure, simple, and delicious. Try it as a dipping sauce with your Chicken McNuggets®. Sweet ‘N Sour Sauce Sweet 'N Sour Sauce at McDonald's is a sweet and sour apricot and peach-flavored sauce with savory spices and slight lingering heat. Condiments & Other Sauces Ketchup McDonald’s sweet, classic topping made from red ripe tomatoes. Mustard Mustard adds a tangy taste and a tiny hint of spice to your meal. Mayonnaise The perfect thick, creamy sandwich topper made with egg yolk, mustard flour and vinegar. Tartar Sauce McDonald's tartar sauce is the creamy, classic Filet-O-Fish® topper made with pickle relish, onion, and parsley. However you want to order, make sure it’s easy Enjoy McDonald’s on your terms Order Pickup Scan the code, download the McD’s app & start earning points.* Order Pickup Scan the code, download the McD’s app & start earning points.* *Must opt-in to Rewards to receive points on eligible purchases in the app. You will not earn points when ordering delivery through this website.
